correctness.rationale: For positive three-species system xdot=x(r-bx+theta yz), ydot=y(lambda-y), zdot=z(y-lambda), product yz=q is conserved identically. On each q leaf x has logistic growth g_q=r+theta q. With x,y nonstationary and g_q/lambda positive noninteger, x(e^-lambda t) has a noninteger leading exponent but 1,y,z are integer-power analytic, proving exact single-leaf regressor rank 4 and kernel span(yz-q). Distinct q0,q1 kill the kernel, yielding pooled rank 5 and unique five coefficients. Exact subtraction yields theta(q1-q0) rate and theta(q1-q0)/b limiting abundance discrepancy. Independent symbolic checks and an unrelated rational exact full-rank five-point sample support the proof.
